sections.content: Analytics workloads differ from OLTP: warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) store historical data columnar-style for fast aggregations over billions of rows.
ETL/ELT pipelines move data from production DBs into the warehouse nightly; star schemas (fact + dimension tables) are the standard modeling pattern.
Key points: OLTP optimizes writes+point reads, OLAP optimizes scans+aggregates, never run analytics on production OLTP, and partition large tables by date.

sections.codeExample:

fact_sales(sale_id, date_id, product_id, amount)
dim_products(product_id, name, category)
